a.lede: Whoop, a company that makes screenless fitness trackers, has launched its own social network.
a.title: Whoop Humans is a social network designed for fitness enthusiasts

b.lede: Starting Thursday, Whoop members can share their data from its wearables on the app's new Whoop Humans social network. Users can make their metrics, activities, and achievements visible to other Whoop wearers, post Story-like "Moments" with photos and captions, and add comments and reactions on other members' posts.
